elapsed_time_s: event-relative logger time; starts at 0 for each event
mass_or_transferred_mass: calibrated mass-flow channel or monotonic transferred mass
protocol_phase: controller phase label mapped to start, fill, hold, stop
vehicle_pressure_mpa: receiving-vessel pressure at the vehicle boundary
vehicle_temperature_c: receiving-vessel gas temperature at the vehicle boundary
selected_cascade_bank: selected cascade bank label with facility-specific identity removed
